title: Precipitation history for your land
description: Your own period, the rain gauge readings and the service’s estimate, available for comparison.

blocks.text: The last twenty-four hours or a calendar month do not always match how a person follows their land.

quote.text:
App seems to be less and less accurate with rain totals and is taking for ever to load with full WiFi 
I’ve had this app

blocks.text: Choose an arbitrary range, add manual measurements and notes about the watering. Do not mix different sources into one unlabeled total.
The information can differ in spatial accuracy and in age. That has to be visible in the comparison.
